hooks.command: echo $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS | grep -q 'uv.lock' && echo 'BLOCK: Do not edit uv.lock directly. Use uv sync instead.' && exit 1 || exit 0

echo $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS | grep -q 'serialization.py' && git diff crosscat/serialization.py 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '_ARRAY_FIELDS|PackedCrossCatState' && ! git diff crosscat/serialization.py 2>/dev/null | grep -q '_SCHEMA_VERSION' && echo 'BLOCK: Adding new fields to PackedCrossCatState requires bumping _SCHEMA_VERSION in serialization.py' && exit 1 || exit 0

echo $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS | grep -qE '(inference|packed_inference)\.py$' && ! echo $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS | grep -q '__init__.py' && echo 'WARN: If adding new public functions to inference modules, remember to export them in __init__.py' || true
uv run ruff format --quiet $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS && uv run ruff check --fix --quiet $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS
echo $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS | grep -q '.py$' && uv run mypy --no-error-summary $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS 2>/dev/null || true

echo $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS | grep -q 'packed/' && git diff $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS 2>/dev/null | grep -q '+.*@jax.jit' && echo 'WARN: New @jax.jit decorator in packed/ — verify it is not inside a lax.scan/vmap target (it will be inlined and have no effect)' || true

echo $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS | grep -q 'tests/test_' && git diff $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS 2>/dev/null | grep -q '+.*gibbs_sweep\|+.*n_sweeps' && ! git diff $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS 2>/dev/null | grep -q '+.*pytest.mark.slow' && echo 'WARN: New test uses Gibbs sweeps — consider adding @pytest.mark.slow' || true
